title: C509 revocation consume-path per-op microbench on EMULATED nRF52840-DK (software, LRev E4)

test.description: Single emulated nRF52840 node runs the compute-only rev-ops-bench (no radio): crl-parse, crl-lookup, ocsp-lookup, ocspreq-build (batched to resolve the ~16us rtimer) and one ecdsa-verify per sample. Cycle-accurate emulated-nRF per-op timing for the C509 revocation consume path -- the revocation analogue of the LICE C509->DER-overhead measurement. Passes when the node prints its REV-OPS-END block.
